notes: Patches to the parsed Discipline powers, rituals, ceremonies and formulae. Supplements (part F2): reprints PG renamed are merged into the PG entry (the old name stays as an alias); titles the text layer garbles are renamed; entries the parser cannot read are added from the page.

merge.why: Companion pr 24 prints the Auspex 2 power as 'Obeah' (Amalgam Fortitude 1); the Players Guide pr 70 reprints the same power as 'Panacea' (same level, amalgam, cost and pool) and its Unburdening the Bestial Soul names Panacea as the prerequisite. Kept as one entry with the alias.

Cults pr 204 prints the Oblivion 2 power (Amalgam Auspex 2) as Fatal Precognition; the Players Guide pr 87 reprints it as Fatal Prediction. One entry, the Cults name kept as an alias (Trails of Ash and Bone cites it by that name).
Cults pr 205 Where the Shroud Thins = Players Guide pr 87 Where the Veil Thins (the PG renamed the Shroud to the Veil).
Cults pr 213 Split the Shroud = Players Guide Split the Veil (same rename).

add.name: Koldunic Sorcery
add.why: Blood Sigils pr 61, printed in a box the parser skips: a Level 1 Blood Sorcery power a Tzimisce takes with the first Blood Sorcery dot to become a koldun (taken again for each further element); cost one Rouse Check plus Aggravated damage. The Koldunic rituals (pr 62, 66, 71) need it. The page also says it is taken with the first Blood Sorcery dot (at_first_dot) and taken again for each further element (repeatable).
